court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Vijaymala Swapnil Kendre @ Vijaymala ... vs Swapnil Dnyanoba Kendre

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mrs. Vijaymala S. Kendre @ Vijaymala, Applicant (wife)

facts_of_case: The applicant-wife seeks transfer of proceedings initiated by the respondent-husband under section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of proceedings to establish hardship.
legal_principles.held: Issue of hardship is supported by the fact that in case if the Applicant is made to attend the said proceedings at Mumbai, she will be required to travel one way distance of 550 kilometers.

legal_principles.principle: A party's hardship can be established by showing the inconvenience or difficulty caused by attending proceedings at a distant location.
legal_principles.held: It is further brought to my notice that Applicant-Wife is not getting any maintenance from the Non-Applicant.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings transferred to Civil Judge Senior Division at Latur.

use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
arguing hardship in family court proceedings
